Latest Business stories

Business

Wed Nov 4markets

Dow jumps 1,569 points, or 3%, to 53,356.12

It was the index's best day since April 9, 2025, and it came a day after Democrats won both chambers of Congress.

Wed Nov 4crypto

Riot signs $28B AI data center lease

The 15-year, 910 MW lease with a frontier AI lab covers Riot's entire Corsicana, Texas campus and lifts its contracted data center revenue to about $38B.

Wed Nov 4markets

Revolut valued at $115B, up 53% in a year

Existing shares changed hands in a secondary sale and no new money was raised; a year ago the fintech was priced at $75B.

Wed Nov 4markets

ADP: US private employers add 86,000 jobs in Oct

That matched September's revised total, while professional and business services shed 27,000.

Wed Nov 4markets

Euro zone inflation hits 4.0% in Oct, from 3.8%

Eurostat's flash estimate shows energy prices up 20.8% on the year while core held at 2.5%.

Wed Nov 4crypto

Circle Q3 revenue, reserve income up 17% to $865M

USDC onchain volume grew 49% to $13.9T and $182M came from the ARC token presale.

Wed Nov 4crypto

Morgan Stanley tokenizes stocks, Treasurys via DTCC

The bank says it is among the first users of DTCC's new tokenization service, which launched with 20 firms including JPMorgan and Citi.

Mon Nov 2crypto

Mercado Bitcoin pauses withdrawals after hack

Brazil's largest exchange says it contained the breach and customers were unharmed; trackers estimate $40M-$46M left wallets on 10+ chains.

Mon Nov 2crypto

OKX-ICE tokenized stock objectors reach 50

Nvidia, Costco and Nike are among 12 new names in the venue's Oct 30 notice, up from 9 on Oct 15.

Mon Nov 2crypto

BTCPay Server tells merchants to shut down after hot wallet thefts

BTCPay says it is probing reports that attackers with admin access swept hot wallets; its founder said they involve versions before 2.4.2.

Mon Nov 2crypto

Hong Kong moves tokenized deposit settlement to 24/7

The HKMA pilot now settles interbank tokenized deposit trades in tokenized central bank money around the clock, with 12 banks taking part.

Mon Nov 2crypto

Strategy adds 811 BTC for $65.5M, now holds 849,327

Its SEC filing shows the Oct 26 to Nov 1 purchases averaged $80,846 per coin, funded by MSTR share sales.

Sun Nov 1crypto

Binance reopens withdrawals, says 95% of hack losses covered

Binance later reported $3.64B in net outflows by 15:30 UTC, 2.1% of its $171B in assets.

Sun Nov 1crypto

FBI says North Korea's TraderTraitor behind $6B+ Binance theft

It is the first official US attribution after private analytics firms named the group.

Sun Nov 1crypto

Spot bitcoin ETFs log $643.2M outflow on Oct 30

Friday was the funds' first full session after the Binance hack, led by IBIT and FBTC.

Sat Oct 31crypto

Binance says 90% of $6.3B hack losses covered

The exchange said it used its SAFU fund, insurance fund and treasury so users bear no loss, with 10 major tokens fully backed.

Sat Oct 31crypto

Chainalysis says hacker accessed customer data

The blockchain analytics firm said an attacker using AI agent techniques reached names, emails and user IDs, but no passwords or investigation data.

Sat Oct 31crypto

Binance says it has covered 90% of the $6.3 billion stolen in record hack

Binance said on Saturday it has replenished about 90% of the roughly $6.3 billion in tokens stolen from its hot wallets and remains on track to reopen withdrawals on Sunday.

Sat Oct 31security

Chainalysis says AI-assisted hacker accessed some customer names and emails

Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis said a hacker using "offensive agentic techniques" broke into its systems this month and accessed non-sensitive customer data such as names, email addresses and user IDs.

Fri Oct 30crypto

Binance eyes Sunday withdrawal restart

Co-CEO Richard Teng said withdrawals stay paused until a rebuilt system passes testing, with a full reserves report due Monday, Nov 2.

Fri Oct 30markets

Reddit falls 30% on $1B-$1.03B Q4 outlook

Q3 revenue rose 53% to $895M, but CEO Steve Huffman said Google's AI search features are cutting referrals.

Fri Oct 30crypto

Tether Q3 profit $1.5B; reserve buffer $7.95B

Excess reserves nearly doubled from $4.1B in June.

Fri Oct 30crypto

Binance sets aside $6.34B after record $6.3B hack

Binance says about $3B of the stolen crypto is frozen and company funds will cover user losses.

Fri Oct 30markets

Intel Q3 revenue rises 21% to $16.5B; Q4 outlook $15B-$16B

Intel posted Q3 EPS of $0.60, and its Q4 range sits below the quarter just reported.

Fri Oct 30markets

Euro area GDP grows 0.4% in Q3 as France shrinks 0.1%

Eurostat's flash estimate beat the 0.2% expected in a Reuters poll; Germany grew 0.2% and Italy was flat.

Thu Oct 29markets

US Q3 GDP grows 3.4%, up from 2.2% in Q2

Investment led the gain, while September PCE inflation rose to 3.6% year over year, with core at 3.1%.

Thu Oct 29markets

Amazon Q3 sales up 12% to $201.9B; AWS up 39%

Operating income hit $28.1B, a record 13.9% margin, but EPS of $1.89 missed the $1.96 LSEG estimate.

Thu Oct 29crypto

Coinbase Q3 profit $719M; revenue down 35%

About $715M came from gains on crypto it holds; adjusted net income was $78M on $1.22B revenue.

Thu Oct 29crypto

Strategy Q3 net income $19.53B; CFO to step down

A $20.91B gain on its bitcoin drove the result, with 848,517 BTC held as of Oct 25.

Thu Oct 29crypto

Polymarket hit by about $2.7M exploit

It blamed a compromised third-party provider for drained balances on its international platform, paused then resumed trading, and says users will be made whole.

21

Morning Digest

  1. OCC issues first final rule under the GENIUS Act crypto The U.S. bank regulator issued the first federal final rule for stablecoin issuers, effective Jan 18.
  2. UK inflation rises to 3.5% in September markets ONS data show CPI rose 3.5% in the 12 months to September, up from 3.1% in August, with motor fuels the biggest upward driver.
  3. Musk says SpaceX and Tesla are weighing a merger markets On SpaceX's Q3 earnings call, Musk said independent committees at both firms are assessing a tie-up but have not agreed terms.
  4. Zcash developers pick NU7 activation block crypto Developers settled on block 3,543,405, expected around Nov 5, for the NU7 upgrade that cuts block times to 25 seconds from 75.

Evening Digest

  1. PHP patches 2 critical remote-code flaws ai-tech Fixed builds are 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12.
  2. Meta Q3 revenue rises 26% to $64.6B; non-voting stock planned markets The board approved a listed Class C share with no votes, effective January 2027, for capital raising, pay and deals.
  3. Tesla Q3 net income falls 43% to $787M markets Revenue held near $28.0B versus a year earlier while operating expenses rose 39% to $4.8B, so the profit drop came from costs rather than sales.
  4. Solana activates Alpenglow consensus upgrade crypto The Votor phase replaced the TowerBFT voting system at epoch 1064 and targets finality of about 150 milliseconds.

Morning Digest

  1. SoFi launches 4.40% APY tokenized deposit crypto Each SOFIE token is a $1 FDIC-insured SoFi Bank deposit that swaps 1:1 into its SoFiUSD stablecoin, putting a bank deposit that pays interest up against stablecoins that don't.

  4. Researcher: 333 hijacked Tor exits intercepted SSH ai-tech A researcher found the relays, about a tenth of Tor's exits, sending SSH logins to fake servers.
  5. Starknet vote: 93.5% back post-quantum L1 study crypto The non-binding poll lets StarkWare study leaving Ethereum as a layer 2; STRK stays the token.

Evening Digest

  1. US jobless claims fall to 194,000 markets Filings dropped 6,000 in the week to Oct. 17, near the 2026 low of 189,000.
  2. Pentagon bars betting on nonpublic military info markets An Oct. 20 memo from Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth names Polymarket and Kalshi and covers classified and unclassified info.
  3. Ireland fines Coinbase unit €3.25M crypto The regulator says the unit's customer-fund account ran short for long periods in 2020-25, which Coinbase admitted.

Wednesday · Oct 21, 2026 · Morning Digest · crypto

OCC issues first final rule under the GENIUS Act

Binance says it has covered 90% of the $6.3 billion stolen in record hack

The exchange said it drew on its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), part of its futures insurance fund and its corporate treasury, and that users will not bear the loss, CNBC and the BBC reported. Binance said all holdings of 10 major tokens, including BTC, ETH and USDT, are now fully backed, while the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens that may take longer to buy.

Binance said the withdrawal restart is subject to security checks and final confirmation. The company said on Friday it had frozen around $3 billion of the stolen assets, the BBC reported.

Why it matters: The theft is the largest crypto hack on record, and the pace of repayment and the reopening of withdrawals are the main tests of whether customers of the world's largest crypto exchange are made whole.
